intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene (301057) on chromosome Xp21.1.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The disease name SPGFX3 is OMIM's label for X-linked MMAF/asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: The CFAP47 gene is located on chromosome Xp21.1.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: The Xp21.1 deletion removing CFAP47 places the gene at Xp21.1.

paragraphs.text: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of male infertility characterized by asthenoteratozoospermia. Sperm motility is reduced and the sperm flagella show abnormal morphology, placing the disorder within the spectrum of multiple morphologic abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF) (Liu et al. (2021)).

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of male infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility.
checks.explanation: The title states the disorder causes primary male infertility.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is characterized by asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: Asthenoteratozoospermia is named as the phenotype.

checks.claim: In X-linked spermatogenic failure-3, sperm motility is reduced.
checks.evidence_quote: Asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF) has been identified as a sub-type of male infertility.
checks.explanation: Asthenoteratozoospermia means reduced sperm motility, and the mouse model also showed reduced motility.

checks.claim: In X-linked spermatogenic failure-3, the sperm flagella show abnormal morphology.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: MMAF means multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 falls within the spectrum of multiple morphologic abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: Every affected man showed the MMAF phenotype.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) established that SPGFX3 is inherited in an X-linked pattern: affected men carry hemizygous mutations in CFAP47, a gene on the X chromosome.

checks.claim: SPGFX3 is inherited in an X-linked pattern.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The paper describes the disorder as X-linked.

checks.claim: Men affected with SPGFX3 carry hemizygous mutations in CFAP47.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: The affected men carried hemizygous CFAP47 variants.

checks.claim: CFAP47 is a gene on the X chromosome.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: CFAP47 is described as an X-linked gene.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) performed whole-exome sequencing in infertile men with asthenoteratozoospermia and identified hemizygous mutations in the CFAP47 gene. Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays showed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men carrying deleterious missense variants in CFAP47. Liu et al. (2021) linked loss of CFAP47 to defective sperm flagellar structure and reduced sperm motility.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) performed whole-exome sequencing in infertile men with asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: WES data from an additional cohort of severe asthenoteratozoospermic men originating from Australia
checks.explanation: Whole-exome sequencing was done in men with MMAF and in a cohort of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) identified hemizygous mutations in the CFAP47 gene in infertile men with asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: we conducted whole-exome sequencing (WES) and identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: Hemizygous CFAP47 mutations were found in the sequenced men.

checks.claim: Three men carried deleterious missense variants in CFAP47.
checks.evidence_quote: revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47
checks.explanation: Three men carried deleterious missense variants.

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays showed obviously reduced CFAP47 levels in spermatozoa from all three men carrying deleterious missense variants in CFAP47.
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47.
checks.explanation: The draft restates this sentence almost word for word.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) linked loss of CFAP47 to defective sperm flagellar structure.
checks.evidence_quote: the adult males of which were sterile and presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement
checks.explanation: Reduced or deleted CFAP47 in men and mutant Cfap47 in mice were both linked to abnormal flagellar morphology (MMAF). The abstract reports reduced CFAP47 levels rather than literal 'loss', but the whole-gene deletion supports the link.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) linked loss of CFAP47 to reduced sperm motility.
checks.evidence_quote: the adult males of which were sterile and presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement
checks.explanation: Reduced sperm motility is shown in mice and implied in men by the term asthenozoospermia.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) found that adult male mice with Cfap47 mutations were sterile and had reduced sperm motility, a phenotype resembling the asthenoteratozoospermia seen in men with CFAP47 mutations.

checks.claim: Adult male mice with Cfap47 mutations were sterile.
checks.evidence_quote: We also generated a Cfap47-mutated mouse model, the adult males of which were sterile

checks.claim: Adult male mice with Cfap47 mutations had reduced sperm motility.
checks.evidence_quote: the adult males of which were sterile and presented with reduced sperm motility

checks.claim: The phenotype of male mice with Cfap47 mutations resembles the asthenoteratozoospermia seen in men with CFAP47 mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: Altogether, our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The abstract presents the mouse and human findings together as showing the same disorder (reduced motility and abnormal flagella). It does not use the word 'resembles'; the resemblance is inferred from these matching features.

references.label: Liu et al. (2021)
references.citation: Liu C, Tu C, Wang L, Wu H, Houston BJ, Mastrorosa FK, Zhang W, Shen Y, Wang J, Tian S, and others. Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility. Am J Hum Genet 108: 309-323, 2021. [PubMed: 33472045]
